arm_isolation: same original cutoff, independent environment copies; no actor access to private world/class identity/state/target; no sharing results or caches between arms or records
certificate_definition: nonempty compatible candidate class with one target value; actual-target correctness is a later audit, never a silent preselection filter
commitment: both selections, allowed responses, issued certificates and forecasts for all draws committed before any privileged target join
input_boundaries: only two bound queries; terminal target/continuation/extra outputs forbidden; exact field schema, identity, original-state and isolation negative controls required
mechanism_diagnostics: possible gains and losses before actual responses
missing: technical_incomplete; retain plannedN and partial-identification bounds; no automatic replacement

candidate: maximize number of nonempty singleton-target response branches

primary_denominator: all5000planned draws; both arms paired; singleton histories and duplicates retained
question: Does the development-selected target-pure-branch rule yield more conditional certificates than fixedq0 under the same one-observation contract, and at what extra structural work?

sampling_frame.exclusion_scope: All classes in the registered RESULTS238 and239 development/evaluation draws, with the earlier catalog exclusions inherited. Not a claim of never seen in all historical research or catalog construction.

statistics.estimand: Delta = P(candidate certificate only) - P(reference certificate only) over all planned draws
statistics.meaningful_effect_status: Design choice: 20 net additional certificates per1000 draws. Not an empirical prediction or deployment utility threshold.
statistics.planning_reference_reason: Allows wins AND losses and15% total discordance, above old193/1600=12.0625% query-disagreement fraction. This is a planning scenario, not a proven upper bound for the new population.
statistics.positive_direction_power_uses: Exact rational conditional binomial boundary with one tail1/80, equivalent to central two-sided McNemar alpha0.025; NOT the earlier illustrative alpha0.05 test
statistics.primary_interval: Bonferroni rectangle: central97.5% Clopper-Pearson intervals for theta=P(discordance) and beta=P(candidate win|discordance); transform four corners by theta*(2*beta-1)
statistics.primary_support_rule: valid complete evidence and lower endpoint for Delta strictly above0
statistics.sample_size_selection: First candidate N with numerical analytic positive-direction power >=0.90 in the prespecified planning reference; otherwise design_not_ready, no silent extension.

stopping: one fixed-N final analysis; technical failure may stop acquisition but cannot redefineN; no outcome-based extension
wrong_certificate: preserve raw counts and evidence; invalid_certificate_hold; no clean superiority inference, deletion, repair or replacement draw
